idea: A Reiki master with no music background used AI to write a UK No. 2 hit, and people carried it the rest of the way. So it is not AI versus human: the songs you dance to are already both.
flow: Cold open: talking head over Movin' To The Sun and Bad Times, the songs people already know.
Who wrote it: Bernadett Gango, a Reiki master with no music background, typing lyrics into Suno as Imael Angel.
How AI got her in the door: an AI voice, a viral demo, Shazam.
The people who finished it: HUGEL and Ultra Nate rebuilt one, Cali Bee re-sang the other, Universal licensed it.
Both at once: the Grammys split one song, AI for songwriting, human for performance.
ending: The song you can't stop dancing to is already both, and that's how music gets made now.
takeaway: People stop asking whether something is AI or human, and see AI letting new people into every field, theirs included.
angle: The outsider is the way in; it is not AI versus human is the heart. No 3 things you can do.
tone: Playful and surprising, music first, then his usual face-with-proof format.
